description: Fill the open days of a week that already has a plan; dinners already planned, locked or answered stay where they are. Queued like plan_week; ask get_planning_status with the jobId. Uses the household's monthly credits.

allowNearMisses.description: Whether a day may bend a soft rule rather than stay without a dinner. Defaults to false; pass true only after the user said yes to small deviations for the days left open.

weekStart.description: Any date in the week; resolved to that week's plan.

name: replan_open_days
title: Plan the open days
